evals.prompt: Design a responsive reader navigation header with theme selector and quick settings button using project design standards.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates a responsive navigation header utilizing OKLCH design tokens (bg-background, text-foreground, border-border), container query utilities (@container), semantic HTML elements (header, nav), View Transition attributes, and references performance budget limits.
assertions: Uses OKLCH semantic design tokens from globals.css
Uses semantic HTML elements without redundant ARIA roles
Includes View Transition support for page/panel navigation

evals.prompt: Scaffold a multi-column dashboard card layout for book analytics respecting editorial minimalist design guidelines.
evals.expected_output: The agent designs a card layout using CSS grid with minmax/fluid spacing, Instrument Serif font tokens for headings, Geist body text, Card components from packages/ui, and container queries for sub-component responsiveness.
assertions: Adheres to editorial minimalist aesthetic from DESIGN.md
Uses Instrument Serif for display headings and Geist for body text
Implements fluid grid layout using CSS Grid and container queries
